audience: fleet managers who track vehicle locations, idling and fault codes in GPS Insight

useCases.title: See where vehicles are now
useCases.text: List the vehicles on the account, then read the latest location of one vehicle with its speed and ignition state.

useCases.title: Review idle time and fault codes for a day
useCases.text: List the idle periods of one vehicle on one day, and the fault codes that vehicle reported that day.

useCases.title: Compare driving scores for a period
useCases.text: Get the driving score of one vehicle for a period, with its daily scores and the events behind them.

useCases.title: Check fuel card spend for a vehicle
useCases.text: List the fuel card transactions of one vehicle between two days.

useCases.title: Review alerts of the last days
useCases.text: List the alert types on the account, then read the alert history of one vehicle or one alert.
